title: Sei Divertimenti per due violini, alto e violoncello... Opera XI. Libro quarto di quartetti. Nuovamente stampati a spese di G. B. Venier. [G 177]
institution: Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Musique, VM7-1311
gerard_established_by: Title: 'Opera XI. Libro quarto'. Same shelfmark VM7-1311 as btv1b10870902b -- a second ark for the same set. The 'libro N di quartetti' series is Boccherini's own numbering and is corroborated by RISM records that carry GerB numbers: libro primo=990005852 (G159), secondo=990005861 (G165-170), terzo=990005866 (G171), quarto=VMA-3887(4) which cites Gerard 177 itself, quinto=990005874 (G183).
rism_related_established_by: This copy is not in RISM -- it was found on a library portal. These are RISM's records for the same print of the same works (GerB 177, 178, 179, 180, 181, 182), matched on the Gérard set. They describe the edition, not this copy.
